t: This is John Ball Primary School in Blackheath, a community school for children aged three to eleven. It is named after John Ball, a fourteenth century Lollard priest who preached to the people taking part in the Peasants' Revolt on Blackheath. The heath is the same open ground nearby, so the name ties the school to something that happened in this very area. The schoolchildren here carry the name of a preacher who spoke to the rebels.
